French alternative money manager Tikehau Capital plans to step up its investments in the UK, betting a surge in inflation and higher borrowing costs will strain businesses and help create opportunities for assets on the cheap.

The British market is “very competitive” and Tikehau may raise sterling-denominated capital if its investments in the country continue to increase, Antoine Flamarion, co-founder of the firm that oversees €51.7 billion ($56.7 billion), said in an interview in London.
